issues.detail: Missing explicit handling of missing environment variables or build errors.
Assumes Node.js 22/24 and Next.js, limiting applicability to other platforms.

scenarios.name: init-pages-collection
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully satisfies the rubric, while Response B discusses Sanity instead of TinaCMS and misses all required steps.

scenarios.name: list-tutorial-posts
scenarios.rationale: Response A correctly uses the generated client, applies the required filter, sort, and last parameters, and maps edges to node objects, but it does not explicitly return an array of titles as the rubric demands; Response B does not use the client at all and therefore fails to meet the rubric.
